# Aditya Manglik

> Senior Engineer at Qualcomm Technologies and researcher in sustainable
> computing, DRAM and memory systems, and operating-system energy and carbon
> attribution. Co-host of The Week in Green Software (Green Software
> Foundation). Green Software Champion.

Homepage: https://adityamanglik.github.io/
Canonical entity: https://adityamanglik.github.io/#person

## Profiles

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/adityamanglik/
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=hEy3GXAAAAAJ&hl=en
- GitHub: https://github.com/adityamanglik
- Green Software Champions: https://champions.greensoftware.foundation/champions/aditya-manglik/

## Publications

- Compile-Time Energy and Carbon Footprint Estimation (2026). SC4RC 2026. https://adityamanglik.github.io/publication/compile-time-carbon-2026/

- MATSA: An MRAM-Based Energy-Efficient Accelerator for Time Series Analysis (2024). IEEE Access. https://adityamanglik.github.io/publication/matsa/
- NEON: Enabling Efficient Support for Nonlinear Operations in Resistive RAM-based Neural Network Accelerators (2022). Arxiv. doi:10.48550/arXiv.2211.05730 https://adityamanglik.github.io/publication/neon/

- RevaMp3D: Architecting the Processor Core and Cache Hierarchy for Systems with Monolithically-Integrated Logic and Memory (2022). Arxiv. doi:10.48550/arXiv.2210.08508 https://adityamanglik.github.io/publication/revamp3d/
- GenPIP: In-Memory Acceleration of Genome Analysis by Tight Integration of Basecalling and Read Mapping (2022). MICRO-55. doi:10.48550/arXiv.2211.04369 https://adityamanglik.github.io/publication/genpip_micro2022/
- A Case for Transparent Reliability in DRAM Systems (2022). Arxiv. doi:10.48550/arXiv.2204.10378 https://adityamanglik.github.io/publication/dram_minesh/

## Projects

- Travel log: Places visited over the years https://adityamanglik.github.io/project/travel_log/

- Course log: Log for courses over the years https://adityamanglik.github.io/project/course_log/
- Nand2tetris: Project implementation for the nand2tetris course on Coursera https://adityamanglik.github.io/project/nand2tetris/
- Power attribution and Estimation Engine in Linux: To design and develop high performance, lightweight power measurement and attribution systems inside Linux. https://adityamanglik.github.io/project/linuxenergy/

- Adaptive Gait Generation for Hexapod: Use Genetic Algorithm for teaching a hexapod how to walk, even with damaged limbs https://adityamanglik.github.io/project/adaptivegaitgeneration/
